comparisons.reason: Same source (OC_comments) and any/binary/null/empty rules, but constructs differ. Left: any concrete real-world example (case, event, person, statistic-bearing situation, personal experience) used to support a point. Right: a concrete external analogy, meaning a real-world case used as a comparison to the issue, from outside the OP's scenario, with restatement of the OP's examples excluded. Right is a narrower subtype (analogical comparison) and has an extra OP-scenario exclusion. Left counts any supporting example, including personal experience and statistics, which are not necessarily analogies.
